inputKind: a String of one or more lowercase words separated by single spaces
inputs: 'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the end'

tasks.prompt: Leave the longest word; when several are equally long, the first of them.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET

tasks.prompt: Leave the word that occurs most often; when several occur equally often, the one whose first occurrence comes first.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET

tasks.prompt: Leave the distinct words in alphabetical order, joined by single spaces into one String.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE UNIQUE SORT [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN -1 DROP JOIN

tasks.prompt: Leave the words in reverse order, joined by single spaces into one String.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE REVERSE [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN -1 DROP JOIN

tasks.prompt: Leave the text with the first letter of every word in upper case, the words still separated by single spaces.
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS 'C' BIND C 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN -1 DROP JOIN

tasks.prompt: Leave one String of the upper-case first letters of the words longer than three letters, in order (the empty String when there are none).
tasks.reference: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
